boundaryFindings: ProjectGuid::new generates UUID v4; checked conversion and manual Deserialize reject nil only. UUID version/variant and cross-project uniqueness are not enforced by the wrapper. The owned nil test exercises FromStr and Deserialize; both call try_from_uuid.

ProjectManifestDigest hashes exactly the provided bytes without reading a path or applying a byte cap. Text parse and Deserialize require exactly 64 lowercase ASCII hex characters. Whitespace changes can alter the digest while preserving TOML meaning.

ProjectIdentity construction and Serde do not authenticate common origin, current file contents, canonical physical resolution or admission. CanonicalDescriptorIdentity checks lexical path shape; Editor filesystem resolution and revalidation establish the physical boundary.

Editor preflight reads bounded bytes and derives the digest from that same buffer. Runtime package-lock input separately pins/limits/compares manifest bytes and GUID. Hub tests/callers are foreign dirty inputs and were inspected without edits.
